name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years' continuous permanent residence, renunciation of prior citizenship, demonstrated legitimate income, commitment to constitutional compliance, and state (Uzbek) language proficiency -- with exemptions for applicants over 60, persons with disabilities, or those educated in Uzbek. Applications are reviewed by a centralized Commission under the President via the digital 'E-Fuqaro' interdepartmental database, with roughly a 1-month timeline per review stage; final decisions are discretionary presidential decrees, not automatic on Commission recommendation alone.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years' continuous residence, secure legitimate income, pass the language requirement (or qualify for an exemption), and renounce prior citizenship.

requirements.blocker_text: Applicants with at least one relative in a direct ascending line (parent, grandparent) who is a citizen of Uzbekistan qualify for a simplified procedure, still requiring language proficiency and legitimate income but without the standard 5-year residency clock.
requirements.fix_path: Apply under the simplified procedure with proof of the ascending-line relative's citizenship.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous residence (general procedure)
Proof of ascending-line relative's citizenship (simplified procedure)

sources.title: lex.uz (National Database of Legislation, Republic of Uzbekistan) -- Presidential Decree DP-6185 of 10.03.2021, 'On the implementation of the updated procedure for consideration of issues of citizenship': general and simplified (compatriot) naturalisation procedures, the E-Fuqaro digital system, and the presidential-decree final-decision structure

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Uzbekistan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government sourcing via lex.uz, Uzbekistan's own official legislation portal (tier 1), one of the more solidly-sourced citizenship files built in this dataset. The 'compatriot' simplified track (ascending-line relative) is modeled as a requirement_group INSIDE this naturalisation file rather than as a separate ancestry-category file, following the same convention used for Kazakhstan's Kandas ethnic-repatriate fast-track built earlier in this dataset -- both are framed as expedited naturalisation procedures rather than distinct legal categories. DISCRETIONARY STRUCTURE, EXPLICITLY FLAGGED: even after meeting all objective conditions, the final decision is a presidential decree following non-binding Commission recommendations -- there is no automatic-grant mechanism described in the source, consistent with the discretionary-naturalisation pattern seen in several other countries in this dataset (Lebanon, Kuwait, Senegal). dual_citizenship_allowed set false given the general procedure's explicit renunciation-of-prior-citizenship requirement.
